items.text: TaskListStore consumes snapshots and domain commands. Feature code cannot drive a socket or a ModelContext. Existing composer, approval, question, queued follow-up and attachment suites retain their state transitions. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`

Send and follow up through the app. Exercise the injected transcriber and Live Activity adapter through their existing smoke paths. `cmd:scripts/demo/followup.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/voice.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/live-activity.sh`
